{{Top|leg}}
'''Nanopincers''' were used in the [[Spin-sealed|spin-sealing]] process for [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]]. They were used to arrange the spin-sealed atoms closer together so that their unnatural shape would hold tight at higher temperatures.
